description: This file is a shell script responsible for firmware upgrade management on a device, including checking for updates, downloading firmware images via curl, handling reboot scheduling within maintenance windows, and interacting with various system components and RFC configurations.

methods.name: IsCodebigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the Codebig service is blocked based on a timestamp stored in a file, preventing further codebig connections if within a block window.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Configures whether to use Codebig or direct connection by querying device and server configuration, setting the connection strategy accordingly.

methods.name: checkFirmwareUpgCriteria
methods.description: Compares current firmware version and target firmware version to decide if an upgrade is available based on detailed version parsing rules.

methods.name: checkFirmwareUpgCriteria_temp
methods.description: Temporarily checks if the current and target firmware versions are identical, used in simplified upgrade criteria.

methods.name: getRequestType
methods.description: Determines request type based on domain name, distinguishing between SSR and other responses for signing requests.

methods.name: adjustDate
methods.description: Adjusts device date/time, retrying up to 10 times if needed, used for synchronization before secure communication.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpgDetail
methods.description: Main function to contact XCONF server, retrieve firmware info, and decide whether to download, handling retries and multiple protocols.

methods.name: fetchFirmwareDetail
methods.description: Fetches firmware download details from the last saved response file, used in delayed or scheduled checks.

methods.name: calcRandTime
methods.description: Calculates random delay times within maintenance windows for scheduled update checks or reboots.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the WAN interface.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines the build type (DEV, VBN, PROD, GSLB) based on version.txt content.

methods.name: removeLegacyResources
methods.description: Performs cleanup of legacy log files.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceWindow
methods.description: Checks whether the current time falls within predefined maintenance windows for reboot scheduling.

methods.name: checkrfcstatus
methods.description: Signals RFC agent to process configuration files, waiting for completion.

methods.name: main application logic
methods.description: Orchestrates the overall firmware update process, including initial setup, download management, reboot scheduling, and cleanup, based on device state, configuration, and server responses.
